name: empty
why: era 30 (L2 + D8b): a bulldoze costs 5 before difficulty scaling, so clearing ground is charged at every difficulty for the first time since slice 1.3; and the tools and the fixture runner now load data/quests/, which has no mirror, so a quest can fire in a replayed city at last. The events changed because questOffered is one: the empty region is offered a quest on its eleventh tick, which it never could be before.
